name: StandX DUSD
oneLiner: DUSD is StandX's delta-neutral synthetic dollar, redeemable 1:1 against USDT/USDC and backed by hedged BTC/ETH/SOL positions on CEXes via Ceffu custody.
collateral: USDT/USDC deposits converted to hedged crypto positions (BTC, ETH, SOL) via Ceffu
pegMechanism: Delta-neutral hedging on centralized exchanges; 1:1 USDT/USDC redemption

oracleRisk.summary: StandX documents multiple independent price feeds, median selection, deviation circuit breakers, secondary networks, TWAP fallbacks, and manual intervention for its managed collateral and hedging system.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: DUSD is minted from USDT or USDC into a managed vault and offchain hedging system, and redemption uses a seven-day unwind period. StandX monitors collateral, hedge positions, and liquidation triggers operationally, but users do not open permissionless per-collateral debt positions with independently inventoried onchain auction, backstop, and shutdown branches.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Solana slot 425778638, the tracked Token-2022 DUSD mint reported H4Mp7WL282pdbY9V9N7AJnsQwB5yyrU1E7svfsH2Ur5h as both mintAuthority and freezeAuthority. That authority is a PDA owned by the immutable StandX program STANDKqqZERMKosYH2PAtNtnt6mig4CRPycsRwjuVhB, so the program can directly freeze individual DUSD token accounts and block their transfers. The separate BSC deployment remains governed through the StandX Gateway role system.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: StandX documents DUSD as chain-native on Solana and BNB Chain with StandX Gateway components handling minting and redemption. No third-party bridge route was verified, so the reviewed topology is issuer-native mint/redeem on each supported chain.

mintAuthority.summary: StandX DUSD is minted on-chain via the protocol Gateway when users deposit USDT/USDC into the StandX Secure Vault; Solana mint authority is a PDA of an immutable StandX program, while BSC live reads resolve DEFAULT_ADMIN to an unverified 171-byte contract and MINTER to the Gateway controller. The unscanned BSC RoleGranted gap keeps the review blocked at manual confidence.

review.evidence: StandX operates a two-layer model (on-chain Gateway + off-chain Settler/RSV multisig). Solana: at slot 425778638, DUSD mint DUSDt4AeLZHWYmcXnVGYdgAzjtzU5mXUVnTMdnSzAttM (Token-2022) has mintAuthority and freezeAuthority H4Mp7WL282pdbY9V9N7AJnsQwB5yyrU1E7svfsH2Ur5h, which is owned by StandX program STANDKqqZERMKosYH2PAtNtnt6mig4CRPycsRwjuVhB. StandX program has upgradeAuthority: None (immutable, programData 4XNF9sPKbX3SAor8mm8HDbWycw7qGC642NJs6mePqXQe at slot 425779135). Solana mint authority is a PDA of an immutable program. BSC: DUSD token 0xaf44a1e76f56ee12adbb7ba8acd3cbd474888122 has slot 0 = 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a (admin proxy pointing to implementation 0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1); slot 1 of that proxy = 0x00b4f9b510893505acefb10ec91cbc972185088e (a second proxy pointing to 0xb69f4f80ec472ff9fe86933ac739329f8f72dc3b, a 31KB AccessControl+UUPS implementation). Partial role resolution on 2026-06-11 at BSC block 103642466: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x6c2404092cb1acfe9a06bc7de61bf619933edba5) = true (a 171-byte unverified contract, structure unresolved) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x2c02f575…) = true (the Gateway controller proxy); hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x6c2404…) = false. Exhaustive enumeration blocked: the historical RoleGranted scan covered ~47M-52M only and keyless BSC log APIs cap ranges, leaving 52M→103.6M unscanned.
